sketch.name: TerminalSlotBoard
sketch.description: A terminal's loading slots through the day: bays by hours, each slot a bar coloured by status with its MOT, a now-line, counts per status and free capacity.
sketch.html: free

props.name: startHour
props.description: First hour of the day shown (0-23).

props.name: now
props.description: Current time as HH:mm, drawn as a vertical line; empty hides it.

props.name: slots
props.description: The loading slots: id, bay, start and end (HH:mm), counterparty, product, mot (R rail, T truck, B barge, P pipeline), status (booked, loading, done, late).

props.name: selected
props.description: Id of the selected slot, outlined; empty for none.

sketch.notes: Simple control (rows are data, no designer-edited items, no library). Bays are the distinct bay values in order of first appearance. Hour labels every hour, every 2 hours when the window is over 12 h; gridlines every hour. Free capacity = bay-hours in the window not covered by any slot (overlaps merged per bay). Status colours: booked = window surface with a muted border; loading = accent fill; done = subdued surface with a green stripe; late = red fill. MOT normalized to its first letter R/T/B/P (default T). Fluid ~400x220 to 1200x600, rows share the height (28-48 px), horizontal scroll only under ~380 px. No card chrome; meant for a GridBoard widget. Native: slots are widgets in a Canvas per bay positioned by percent, tooltip is the widget's tooltip.
